title: 기준 모델 C2MS에 분광 손실을 더한 학습의 반복 시드·다른 센서 확인
hypothesis: the 57 spectral loss (0.01 x mean(1 - cosine)) improves C2MS beyond seed noise: on QB (57 seed 42: RR +0.035 dB, SAM -0.048 deg) and on GF2, WV3 and the WV2 transfer, with seeds 42-44

arms.C2MS_SAM: C2MS + spectral loss 0.01 (57 arm C2MS_SAM), 150 epochs; QB seed 42 is the 57 run (same code and settings), seeds 43-44 and all GF2/WV3 seeds are trained here
arms.C2MS (53, 54): controls of the same seeds: QB from 53, GF2 and WV3 from 54 (not retrained)

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained models evaluated on the WV2 test set (PanCollection convention; WV2 has no training data)

reused_runs.QB_C2MS_SAM_s42: experiment 57 (code, settings and data identical; its best weights and records are referenced, not retrained)

precision: FP16 AMP core training; FP32 transforms/loss/validation/evaluation
ema: shadow copy of the weights updated after every applied optimizer step (26: beta 0.99, starts equal to the initial weights, float states averaged, integer states copied); validated every epoch and selected separately (best_ema.pt); never fed back to training
selection: online: minimum original-scale validation MSE of the online weights including epoch0 (best.pt); EMA: minimum original-scale validation MSE of the EMA weights including epoch0 (best_ema.pt); earliest exact tie
loss: per-pixel MSE on the original batch + 1.0 x per-pixel MSE on the 2x coarser pairs (53 C2MS) + spectral_weight x mean over pixels of (1 - cosine of predicted and GT band vectors) on the original batch
sensor_operators: 54 prepare.py SENSORS (QB, GF2, WV3; WV2 for the transfer test), phase 2

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 (QB: common/evaluation_protocol; GF2, WV3, WV2: the 54 sensor Wald operators); fixed before training
judgement.primary: per target (QB, GF2, WV3, WV2 transfer): C2MS_SAM vs C2MS of the same seeds 42-44, v2.3 label on 3-seed means (noise threshold 0.04 dB); online best weights
judgement.secondary: the EMA best weights reported the same way; SAM gap to U2Net+PAKAN on QB (4.439 deg)
judgement.qualitative: result images with common/result_images.py on scenes 0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 17 (C2MS vs C2MS_SAM, seed 42) for QB and WV2
judgement.reported_only: FR QNR, D_lambda, D_s; coarse-scale validation

limits: controls are the 53/54 runs (same code lineage, data, seeds and schedule)
